cases.facts: Circular beam of radius r incident symmetrically on a hemisphere of radius 2r and index 3/2. Its base is on a horizontal table. Requested luminous spot radius.
cases.assumptions: Collimated filled beam in unit-index air, rotational symmetry, straight primary transmission in homogeneous geometrical optics. Determine the geometric extent of first incidence at the base. Identifying it with a visible spot additionally requires a contacting surface that registers incident light throughout that footprint. Table optics and visibility are unspecified.
cases.expectation: For signed entrance ordinate h in units of R, the base ordinate is (h/m)/cos(asin(h)-asin(h/m)), where m is the glass/exterior ratio. It is odd and strictly increasing for m>1 in the qualified interval. With a=1/2 and m=3/2, the incident radius in units of r is (2/3)/cos(pi/6-asin(1/3)).
cases.control: Reuse the released v30 curved-entry Beam with the three frozen v30 configurations. Compare public native flat-face ranges against the map at the actual extreme emitted sample ordinates. The continuous full-width span strictly contains the sampled span in these cases.

cases.facts: Parallel rays at 45 degrees enter the plane surface of a half cylinder of index sqrt(2), in the plane perpendicular to the axis. Asked when the rays avoid total internal reflection.
cases.assumptions: Unit-index exterior on both faces; t is the signed entry coordinate on the diameter divided by the cylinder radius. Exclude both flat/arc joints. Consider the first exit encounter of the directly transmitted branch.
cases.expectation: Inside angle beta=30 degrees. Conservation of perpendicular distance to the circle centre gives sin(iArc)=abs(t)*cos(beta). Strict transmission requires abs(t)<sqrt(2/3); equality is the critical limiting direction. TIR occurs above that threshold inside the diameter.
cases.control: Public v21 right semicircle R=100 mm, inside index sqrt(2), outside 1, partialReflection false. One parallel Beam at +45 degrees, width 10 mm, density 0.1, brightness 0.04, x=-40 mm and source y=100*t-40 mm for t=-0.9,-0.7,0,0.7,0.9. Require a complete warning-free native run and compare the real first arc callback with the frozen outcome and incidence. A native refusal or truncation is recorded as a failed witness.

boundaries: No custom native ray tracing, continuous irradiance, scattered light, Fresnel flux, repeated-ray history or native critical-incidence claim. Preserve pinned physics, historical v21/v30 and all frozen artifacts. Keep mathematical boundary, strictly transmitted and TIR branches distinct.
